mapper.select: SELECT * FROM goal WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal (user_id, goal_type, goal_name, target_value, unit, period, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goalType}, #{goalName}, #{targetValue}, #{unit}, #{period}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goal WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
